meta_data.base_class: Generate insights on <specific sector stocks> based on recent market data- applicable for analyzing various stock market sectors with trends over specific days, future performance predictions, and different risk appetites.

tool_template.name: StockInsightGenerator_<class>
tool_template.description: Generate insights on <class> based on recent market data.

industry.description: The specific industry within <class> to focus on.

daysToAnalyze.description: The number of days to analyze for trends of <class>.

predictionDays.description: The number of days to predict future performance of <class>.

riskAppetite.description: The risk appetite of the investor, e.g., 'high', 'medium', 'low'.

region.description: The geographic region to focus on for <class> market insights, e.g., 'North America', 'Europe'.

market_cap_focus.description: Filter the analysis of <class> to focus on a specific market capitalization segment. Options include 'large_cap', 'mid_cap', and 'small_cap'.

reportFormat.description: The format of the insights report for <class>, e.g., 'PDF', 'Excel'.

currency.description: The currency in which the market insights for <class> should be reported, e.g., 'USD', 'EUR'.
